name: Arch body hold
description: Face down, chest and legs lifted. The posterior half of the hollow.

name: Hanging knee raise
description: Knees to chest from a hang, controlled on the way down.

name: Plank
description: Forearms down, ribs tucked, glutes on.

name: Side plank
description: Stacked hips, body in one line.

name: Hollow rock
description: Rock in the hollow position without losing the flat back.

name: Copenhagen plank
description: Side plank with the top leg on a bench. Adductor strength for flags and levers.

name: Seated compression lift
description: Sitting with legs straight, lift the heels off the floor and hold. Builds active compression.

name: Toes to bar
description: Straight legs from a hang until the toes touch the bar.

name: Dragon flag negative
description: From shoulders on the bench, lower the straight body slowly.
